name: What actually happens first when I’m getting new kitchen countertops installed?

mainEntity.name: What actually happens first when I’m getting new kitchen countertops installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by scheduling an in-home measurement so the installer can confirm cabinet layout, sink and cooktop cutouts, and any uneven walls before fabrication begins. For most Denver-area kitchens, the process then moves to templating, fabrication, and a one-day installation once the cabinets are ready.
acceptedAnswer.description: Book an in-home measurement first. The installer verifies cabinet dimensions, sink and appliance openings, then templates the tops before fabrication and final installation.
